play_store_listing.full_description:
Avoid poison on your plate.

Selorg is India's first lab-tested organic grocery app — your health guardian for clean, toxin-free food delivered to your door.

WHY SELORG?
• Lab-tested organic groceries you can trust
• Clean, healthy food for your family
• Toxin-free products curated for everyday cooking
• Fast delivery to your saved addresses

SHOP WITH EASE
• Browse categories, collections, and deals
• Search products quickly
• Add to cart and checkout in minutes
• Apply coupons and offers
• Pay securely via UPI and supported wallets (PhonePe, GPay, Paytm & more)

TRACK & MANAGE ORDERS
• Real-time order status updates
• Delivery address management with maps
• Order history, ratings & feedback
• Easy returns and refund requests
• In-app wallet for seamless payments

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Tiny Tummies — specially curated picks for little ones
• Push notifications for order updates
• Customer support chat and tickets

Login with OTP, set your delivery location, and begin your clean food journey with Selorg.

We're your health guardian.
